name: Purine ribonucleotide and nucleoside degradation to allantoin
rationale: All members cover breakdown of AMP/IMP and (deoxy)adenosine/inosine via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, whereas confusables cover deoxyribonucleotide/pyrimidine catabolism or purine salvage.

name: Ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: All members concern initiation and branching of the ureteric bud, while confusables cover nephric duct, mesonephros, ureter and nephron morphogenesis.

name: Sex steroid receptor signaling, estrogen and androgen responses
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen and progesterone receptor signaling and responses; unlike the estrogen-only confusables the theme includes androgen/prostate programs, and unlike C1 it includes androgen and estrogen response hallmarks.

name: Organelle transport along microtubules with microtubule severing
rationale: Members concern microtubule-based positioning of mitochondria, lysosomes, endosomes and synaptic vesicles, and the theme uniquely adds microtubule severing/depolymerization absent from all confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism
name: Nuclear receptor (LXR, PPARα, ROR) control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor and coactivator (PGC-1α) transcriptional programs for lipid and energy metabolism; LXR targets, general nuclear receptor transcription and receptor SUMOylation distinguish it from adipogenesis, circadian and ChREBP/SREBP confusables.

core: Cytochrome P450 fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism
name: P450 fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism, ichthyosis defects
rationale: Members are fatty acid, linoleate and eicosanoid metabolism including CYP4F22 and SLC27A4 ichthyosis defects, distinct from the lipoxygenase/cornified envelope and omega-hydroxylase/epoxygenase confusables.

name: Myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion in striated muscle
rationale: All members concern skeletal and cardiac muscle cell development and satellite-cell regeneration, whereas confusables focus on hypertrophy, adaptation and atrophy.

qualifier: with hypoxia, oxidative stress and drug responses
name: Positive regulation of mitochondrial ATP production and stress responses
rationale: Members combine upregulation of respiration and ATP/nucleotide synthesis with responses to hypoxia, oxidative stress and drugs; positive respiration regulation separates it from C1/C4, and the energy members from C2/C3.

name: Mammary and prostate gland epithelial development and branching
rationale: Members are mammary and prostate branching, epithelial differentiation and lactation; prostate members separate it from placental confusables and mammary members from lung/genital ones.

qualifier: stress-induced, with evasion through CDKN2A defects
name: Stress-induced cellular senescence and evasion through CDKN2A defects
rationale: Members concern oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence, SASP and its evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF loss; the CDKN2A defect members distinguish it from SAHF/replicative senescence confusables, and senescence members from p53/p21 confusables.

name: Adrenergic signaling increasing heart rate and contractile force
rationale: Members are adrenoceptor/catecholamine signaling and its effects; positive inotropic and chronotropic cardiac members distinguish it from the Gi/smooth-muscle adrenergic confusables.

name: Notch O-fucosylation and O-glucosylation in somite patterning
rationale: Members are O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins (LFNG, B3GALTL) and somitogenesis, separating it from somite-only and N-glycan, Hedgehog or heparan sulfate confusables.

name: Gluconeogenesis, glucose-6-phosphate handling and fructose catabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis, G6PC/SLC37A4 and glucokinase regulation, and fructose catabolism disorders, whereas confusables center on glycolysis and glycogen metabolism.

name: Cardiac calcium reuptake and sodium-calcium exchange in relaxation
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ in cardiomyocytes via SR import and Na/Ca exchangers to control relaxation and force, unlike confusables centered on ryanodine-receptor release or caffeine responses.

name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signaling in renal sodium and fluid excretion
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signaling plus renal natriuresis, urine volume and glomerular filtration; the renal members distinguish it from eNOS and vascular blood-pressure confusables.

name: Axon guidance and extension by Sema3A and netrin repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and extension control with Sema3A and netrin repulsive signaling, separating it from collateral sprouting, monoaminergic guidance and generic plexin confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and temperature sensing
rationale: Members are K2P channel families with excitability and pain/thermal/itch perception; the K2P channels distinguish it from TRP/tachykinin and taste/smell confusables, and pain sensing from the Ca-activated K+ confusable.

name: Centriole duplication, basal body docking and cilium assembly control
rationale: Members concern centriole assembly/cohesion, basal body organization and regulation of cilium assembly/disassembly, distinct from intraflagellar transport, MTOC and motile-cilium confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K carboxylation and vitamin C
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation together with ascorbate metabolism and vitamin responses, separating it from ROS, BH4 and vitamin K/E catabolism confusables.

name: Cytosolic calcium rise via store release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern raising cytosolic Ca2+ through store release, SOCE and voltage-gated channels, opposite to confusables centered on Ca2+ reduction, exchangers or ER/mitochondrial calcium.

name: TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and succinate oxidation
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates, pyruvate handling and the malate-aspartate shuttle; succinate oxidation and ATP synthesis distinguish it from PDH/CoA confusables, and the shuttle from glutamate and isocitrate confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome separation and spindle formation by PLK1/NEK kinases
rationale: Members concern mitotic spindle assembly and centrosome separation via PLK1 and NEK9/6/7, distinct from spindle checkpoint/cytokinesis and AURKA confusables.

name: Epidermal cornification and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope, hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary placodes; this distinguishes it from melanocyte/MITF, intestinal epithelium and ectodermal-dysplasia confusables.

name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members are cerebellar layer and Bergmann glia/granule cell development plus locomotion, motor learning and righting reflex, distinct from hindbrain/brainstem, proprioception and forebrain confusables.

qualifier: AP-1 induction with MAPK negative feedback
name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members are AP-1/NR4A immediate-early transcription and ERK feedback inactivation; the immediate-early modules separate it from phosphatase and IL-6 confusables, and MAPK feedback from KRAS/FOSL confusables.
